_source: Hand-verified during research: each state's own Secretary of State (or equivalent) official candidate database, checked directly (live network inspection of the real API/page, not scraped from a third party like Ballotpedia) for a machine-readable, no-key, official source that distinguishes a real confirmed general-election candidate from an FEC filer who lost their primary or runoff.
_method: A state with no entry here is simply not yet covered — the ballot page falls back to its prior behavior (every active FEC filer shown) for that state, same as any other partial-coverage feature in this app (ballot measures, county-district crosswalk). This file only ever ADDS accuracy, never removes a state's chance at showing candidates.

CO.source_name: Colorado Secretary of State (Clarity Election Night Reporting)
CO.description: Official statewide results feed, verified live 2026-08-12 against the real 2026 primary (EID 126592): elections.json -> current_ver.txt -> json/sum.json, no API key or auth. All 18 federal contests (8 districts x 2 parties, plus both Senate primaries) parse cleanly. Ground-truthed against the CO-01 Democratic primary, where the feed shows Melat Kiros 83,855 (53.2%) defeating 15-term incumbent Diana DeGette 62,715 with Wanda James third — matching what actually happened on 2026-06-30. runoff_threshold_pct is null because Colorado awards its primary to the plurality leader outright, so the top vote-getter IS the nominee; a runoff state must set this or its runoff-bound leader would be mislabeled.

TX.source_name: Texas Secretary of State (Civix Candidate Bio Portal)
TX.description: Official statewide candidate database, verified live via network inspection (not scraping the rendered Angular SPA): GET .../getElectionsByYear/{year} to find the current cycle's 'GE' (General Election) id, then POST .../findQualifiedCandidates with that id. cdOfficeType='FD' isolates federal races; txOfficeName parses to office+district ('U. S. SENATOR' / 'U. S. REPRESENTATIVE DISTRICT N'); cdFilingStatus='CG' ('Candidate in the General Election') is the authoritative confirmed-nominee flag, verified against known-correct 2026 ground truth (Paxton beat Cornyn in the May runoff; Paxton alone carries CG, Cornyn is absent from the GE-scoped query entirely). No API key, no auth.
